service.title: AI service
service.text: The service {app} sends texts to for the AI, when one serves everybody.
service.urlHint: In the own network http works too, on the internet only https.
service.keyKept: Stays; type only to change it.
service.keyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. A new address without a new key forgets it.

who.title: Who may use AI
who.text: The main switch, the way of access and computers in the own network.
who.enabledHint: Off: no text goes to an AI service. What is set up stays.
who.modeHint: "One for all": the service above. "Each account itself": every person enters their own under My account › AI.
who.hosts: Computers in the own network for own accesses
who.hostsHint: Separated by commas, such as ollama.example.com:11434. Other addresses in the own network stay closed to accounts.
who.perAccount: You allow the AI for single accounts under Server › Accounts › Manage.

limits.title: Limits
limits.text: How often the AI may be asked.

me.title: AI
me.text: Whether {app} may send your texts to an AI service, and where to.
me.mineHint: Off: none of your texts goes to the AI, not even by itself.
me.toLocal: Your texts stay in the own network.

own.title: Own access
own.text: Your own AI service. The key is yours and is stored encrypted.

events.title: What went out
events.text: What {app} sent to the AI in the last 14 days. Only you see this.
events.clearText: What went out stays with the service; only the list goes here.

errors.ai_off: No AI is set up or allowed on this server.
errors.ai_not_allowed: Your operator has not allowed the AI for your account.
errors.ai_switched_off: You switched the AI off for yourself.
errors.ai_app_refused: The AI is not allowed for this.
errors.ai_incomplete: The AI service is not set up completely.
errors.ai_own_off: There are no own accesses on this server.
errors.ai_address_missing: Give the address of the service.
errors.ai_address_invalid: This is not an address of a service.
errors.ai_https_required: {app} reaches a service on the internet over https only.
errors.ai_address_private: This address lies in the own network, and the operator has not listed the computer.
errors.ai_address_mixed: This name points into the own network and onto the internet at once.
errors.ai_hosts_invalid: One of the computers is neither a name nor an address.
errors.ai_unreachable: The server cannot reach the AI service.
errors.ai_timeout: The AI service took too long ({seconds} s).
errors.ai_key_refused: The AI service refused the key.
errors.ai_address_not_found: The AI service does not know this address.
errors.ai_service_busy: The AI service is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.ai_service_failed: The AI service answered with an error.
errors.ai_unreadable: The answer of the AI service could not be read.
errors.ai_empty: The AI service gave back nothing.
errors.ai_used_up: The model used up its room for an answer before it wrote one. A thinking model needs its thinking switched off.
errors.ai_no_list: This service lists no models; type the name of the model.
errors.ai_too_often: Too many requests to the AI. Wait a little.
errors.ai_day_used: The requests to the AI for today are used up.
errors.ai_busy: The AI is already working on a request of yours.
errors.ai_server_busy: The AI is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
